αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
βαῖνε: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε); here tmesis μετέβαινε ’was following’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’)
διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ)
δούρατα: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank (also spear); neut. acc. pl. δούρατα: ’timbers’
δοῦρα: δόρυ — tree-trunk, beam, timber; also spear-shaft, spear; neut. nom./acc. pl.
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’)
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl.
εὐνηθῆναι: εὐνάω — lay in bed; aor. pass. inf. εὐνηθῆναι, used in a middle sense: ’to lie (in bed)’
εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
θανόντι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. dat. sg.: ’(for him) dead’
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κάμμορε: κάμμορος (= κατάμορος) — ill-fated, wretched; masc. voc. sg. (κατά cut short, τ assimilated to μ)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’
κακότητος: κακότης — evil, misery, wretchedness; fem. gen. sg.
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl.
καλλίτριχας: καλλίθριξ — fair-maned, fair-haired (καλός + θρίξ); masc./fem. acc. pl.
καλυψώ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. nom. sg.
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’
κινήσας: κινέω — move, set in motion, shake; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shaking’
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg.
κρήδεμνον: κρήδεμνον — head-veil (of a woman); also the covering or seal of a wine-jar; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ‘wide-ruling’)  ·  also honorific of a chief steward, not a king: κρείων Ἐτεωνεύς ’the lord Eteoneus’
κυμαίνοντα: κυμαίνω — swell, billow (of the sea, from κῦμα ’wave’); pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον: ’billowing, surging’
κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
κύματ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom. pl., elided (κύματ’ = κύματα): ‘waves’
κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’)
λύτο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented root-aorist form (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed, gave way’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (esp. of the gods); masc. nom. pl.
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον)
μέσσῃ: μέσος — middle, mid-; epic μέσσος (doubled σ), fem. dat. sg.
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’)
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’)
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus)
μερμήριξε: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise, turn over in the mind; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμερμήριξε)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’
μιγείη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’should be mixed, had been mixed’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
μυθήσατο: μυθέομαι — speak, say, tell; aor. 3 sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour meant is unsettled); masc. acc. sg.
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe) · also adv. after its verb (anastrophe): ἐτίθει πάρα ’set beside’ (= παρετίθει)
πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl., substantival: ’all of them’ (the seals)
πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πέλαγος: πέλαγος — the open sea, high sea; neut. acc. sg.
παθὼν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
παύσασθαι: παύω — stop, cease; aor. mid. inf., + gen.: ’to cease from’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’)
πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical
πηδάλιον: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. acc. sg.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’
πολυδέσμου: πολύδεσμος — of many bonds, many-lashed; fem. gen. sg. (of a raft lashed together with many ties)
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a long time’ · also adjectival, agreeing with a direct object noun: ‘much’ (πολὺν βίοτον ‘much livelihood’)
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
σχεδίης: σχεδίη — raft; fem. gen. sg. (the raft Odysseus will build, named here for the first time)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj.
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα)
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελεῖται: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil, accomplish; pres. pass. 3 sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’)
τλήσομαι: τλάω — endure, bear up under; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall endure’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τρίαιναν: τρίαινα — trident, Poseidon’s weapon; fem. acc. sg.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., + gen.: ’far from’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg.
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’
φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’
φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg.
φυτεύει: φυτεύω — plant, beget; pres. 3 sg., fig. ’set in motion (a disaster)’
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
χάριν: χάρις — grace, charm; fem. acc. sg.
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλύξαι: ἀλύσκω — flee, escape, avoid; aor. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to escape’ (of Proteus straining to get away)
ἀλύξας: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’)
ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι (mid. ἀπόλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to perish’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, troublesome; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate governing an inf. · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’grievous, hard’ (δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε, of λαῖτμα)
ἀτρεΐδῃσι: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. dat. pl. -ῃσι, of both sons of Atreus together, Agamemnon and Menelaus
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἁρμονίῃσιν: ἁρμονίη — joint, fastening (exact device uncertain: perhaps mortise-and-tenon, clamps, or lashings); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, among; prep. + dat.: ’along, among’
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, squall, gust; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδύσετο: δύω/δύνω — enter, sink into, plunge; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic sigmatic (ἐδύσετο, = Attic ἔδυ): ’she plunged (in)’
ἐικυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’likened to, having the appearance of’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); nom. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐπίκριον: ἐπίκριον — the yard, the spar fixed across the mast from which the sail hangs (a rare word); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐπελήθετο: ἐπιλανθάνομαι — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’forgot’
ἐπισπεῖν: ἐφέπω — follow, meet, come upon (+ acc., of fate); aor. inf. ἐπισπεῖν
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, bear (along, repeatedly); impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying, bore along’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’fell into’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’
ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, drive; impf. 3 pl.
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε)
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj.
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, set in motion; aor. 3 sg.: ’stirred up, roused’
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
